name: Marble Mountains: Thuy Son
why: Up steps through pagodas and Buddhist caves inside a limestone hill between Da Nang and Hoi An, to lookouts over the beach.
book: Ticket at the gate; lift for the first part.
dangers: Dark and slippery inside the caves.

points.name: Marble Mountains gate
points.note: The steps up Thuy Son from Huyen Tran Cong Chua street.

points.name: Tam Thai Pagoda
points.note: The 17th-century pagoda at the top of the steps.

points.name: Vong Hai Dai
points.note: Lookout over My Khe beach and the sea.

points.name: Vong Giang Dai
points.note: Lookout over the river and the other marble hills.
